_themeJsonNote: data/theme.json in this folder now holds the SHIPPED version (sent to Carson Gee via Slack DM on 2026-06-11 for the PR to datarobot-oss/datarobot-agent-skills). It supersedes the Figma 'Raw JSON' frame, which lags behind: the shipped file fixes darkCyan (#909BF5), completes the darkPink->darkTurquoise and lightPink->lightTurquoise renames, updates darkSyntaxYellow (#CEB31C), and adds the full 'theme' role-mapping block (52 roles). The inconsistencies below describe the FIGMA CANVAS state, kept for case-study accuracy.
knownInconsistencies: theme.json defs vs change log: defs still contain darkCyan #30AAB2 (log Round 2: changed to #909BF5; the Figma VARIABLE '8 darkCyan' already resolves to purple-50 #909BF5).

theme.json defs still contain darkPink #E98AD6 and lightPink #D547B8 although the log says they were renamed to darkTurquoise / lightTurquoise; defs DO contain darkTeal #61BFC5 and lightTeal #00949F which carry the new turquoise values.
theme.json darkSyntaxYellow is #E5D74C while palette preview, change log and the Figma variable say #CEB31C.
theme.json has no darkSyntaxOrangeMuted (consistent with 'removed' in Round 3), but the palette preview still shows row 24 SyntaxOrangeMuted with a stale hex #42C0FC (variable resolves to #EDA769).
theme.json contains only $schema + defs; there is no 'theme' role-mapping block (primary/text/syntax etc.), so the file defines colors but does not yet assign them to OpenCode UI roles.
Palette preview line-number gutter (46) vs code snippet lines (48).
lightMagenta is lowercase '#b3003f' in the JSON (only non-uppercase hex).
